data.name: Mursal
data.gender_notes: Mursal is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who asks. The name Mursal carries the meaning “Asker” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Mursal usually hope their child will grow to embody asker and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Mursal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Asker.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mursal total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: مُرْسَل
in_arabic.long_meaning: مُرْسَل ہِ کا معنی ہے رَسول اللٰہ بِالہُدٰی وَالدِین، یعنی اللٰہ تعالیٰ کی طرف سے مُرسَل ہوا ہے، جس کا کام ہے کہ انسانوں کو ہدایت اور دین کی راہنمائی دیں۔ یہ نام قرآن میں بھی موجود ہے، جہاں اللٰہ تعالیٰ اپنے نبی کی بابت فرماتا ہے کہ وہ مُرْسَل ہوا ہے۔ اس نام کا استعمال اسلامی روایات میں بھی کیا جاتا ہے، اور یہ نام اپنے معنی کے مطابق ایک نیک اور مُستقیم کردار کا بھی بھروسہ کرنے کے لئے لگایا جاتا ہے۔

in_urdu.name: مرسل
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ تعالیٰ کی طرف سے مُرسل ہوا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: مرسل کا معنی ہے اللہ تعالیٰ کی طرف سے مُرسل ہوا ہے، جس کا کام ہے کہ انسانوں کو ہدایت اور دین کی راہنمائی دیں۔ یہ نام قرآن میں بھی موجود ہے، جہاں اللہ تعالیٰ اپنے نبی کی بابت فرماتا ہے کہ وہ مرسل ہوا ہے۔ اس نام کا استعمال اسلامی روایات میں بھی کیا جاتا ہے، اور یہ نام اپنے معنی کے مطابق ایک نیک اور مستقل کردار کا بھی بھروسہ کرنے کے لئے لگایا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मुरसल
in_hindi.meaning: प्रभु की ओर से मुरसल हुआ है
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुरसल का अर्थ है प्रभु की ओर से मुरसल हुआ है, जिसका काम है कि मनुष्यों को हिदायत और धर्म की राह दिखाएं। यह नाम कुरआन में भी है, जहाँ प्रभु अपने नबी के बारे में कहता है कि वह मुरसल हुआ है। इस नाम का उपयोग इस्लामी परंपराओं में भी किया जाता है, और यह नाम अपने अर्थ के अनुसार एक अच्छे और स्थिर व्यक्तित्व का भी विश्वास के लिए लागाया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: مرسل
in_pashto.long_meaning: مرسل ځای په معنی خدا له تليد مړلی، دا چا انسانانو ته هدایت او دین په راڅیښنه ده. دا نوم کورټ میږ په کي هم موجود دی، کله کله خدانو بياړه څوک په نوم مرسل ویل کړی دی. دا نوم د اسلامي روایتو په پرتلو څه په کار کښلی دی، او دا نوم په دې معنی کښلی دی چا دا ځانګړي شخص دا د یوه نیک او مستقل کردار بڅرغی کوم کښلی دی.

in_english.name: Mursal
in_english.meaning: Sent by Allah for guidance and religion
in_english.long_meaning: Mursal means sent by Allah for guidance and religion, to guide humans to the right path and the teachings of the faith. This name is also found in the Quran, where Allah refers to His Prophet as one who was sent. In Islamic tradition, this name is used to signify a person of good character and integrity, and is often chosen to convey a sense of trustworthiness and reliability.

data.cultural_impact: The name Mursal is deeply rooted in Islamic tradition and history, as it highlights the importance of asking questions and seeking knowledge in life. In many Islamic communities, asking questions is encouraged as a way to expand one's knowledge and deepen their understanding of the faith and the world around them. This perpetual thirst for knowledge is also reflected in many Islamic texts, such as the hadith of the Prophet Muhammad PEACE BE UPON HIM, where he is recorded as saying: "The seeking of knowledge is obligatory upon every Muslim."
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Mursal carries great significance as it emphasizes the humility and submission required in seeking knowledge and guidance from a higher power. It is a reminder that as beings created by Allah, we are constantly in need of His guidance and wisdom, and that the path to spiritual growth and enlightenment lies in a relentless pursuit of knowledge and understanding. Thus, the name Mursal is a powerful reminder to continually ask questions, seek knowledge, and strive for spiritual growth and development.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Asker" symbolizes One who asks. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Mursal serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of asker.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Mursal ibn Rabiah al-Hadrami was a famous poet from Hadramaut, Yemen, during the 9th century. The name Mursal carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Mursal was a renowned poet from Hadramaut, Yemen, during the Islamic Golden Age.
